new_value: Perplexity CEO publicly committed to a 2028 IPO target (June 9, 2026), holding the line regardless of rival Anthropic/OpenAI filings; CBO casts it as deliberate discipline to build a healthy, high-growth business.
headline: Perplexity sets a concrete 2028 IPO target — signals financial discipline, not desperation
so_what: Reload the 'is Perplexity stable enough to bet on against a trillion-dollar Google?' objection: it's no longer just runway reassurance — there's now a public, self-imposed pre-IPO timeline the rep can cite to reframe Perplexity as a disciplined growth company, not a flight risk.
